snippet.title: Lihiman - Trailer Demo (Game)
snippet.description:
Synopsis:

Lihiman is a Filipino heartwarming anime style s̨͍͖̱̎́̐̆͂ͣ̔ͭ͘͢͠t̴̵̲̮̹̙̜̣̖̫͓͇͔̮̹̀̓̓͊̽ͤͨ̈ͧ́͘͘͜ọ_̧̤̳̈́̋̈́̈́̇́ͧͅŗ̘̜͚̳͓̲̣̌͂͐ͯ͋̍̄͢ͅy̲̻̳̓͛ͩ̔ͤ́͊͋́ͯ͝_̴̶̛̛̗̭͚̗̗̳̊̑ͬ̀̓͑͆̽̐ͤ̊ͫͪ̐_̜ͤ̽͢   game about spending time with your family in the comfort of home. It is not about danger or fear but about the joy of simple moments that make life feel warm and safe.

🎮 Add it to your itch.io collection now:
Link:  https://kiwidreams-01.itch.io/lihiman-demo
